operations.name: CNC Turn — Datum Face and Bore
operations.setup_note: Hold the incoming ring in low-force bored soft jaws with broad axial support, leaving side B accessible. Establish datum Q on F13, then machine the bore and provisionally interpreted internal shoulder without releasing the part.

operations.name: CNC Turn — Reverse Face and Outside Profile
operations.setup_note: Reverse onto a precision bore locator with datum Q against an annular backing face and low-distortion axial clamping. Finish side A, the provisionally interpreted external shoulders, and the outside diameter concentrically with the finished bore.

operations.name: VMC — Axial Holes and Index Slot
operations.setup_note: Locate the turned ring by its bore and datum Q on a supported fixture with clearance beneath the through features. Establish the drawing angular origin only after datum P and the basic feature locations are confirmed.

operations.name: VMC — Cross-Axis Oval Slot
operations.setup_note: Reorient the supported ring so the spindle accesses F06 across the part axis, as stated in the routing view. Locate from the bore and Q, and clock from the confirmed angular reference; release this setup only after the slot section and through extent are defined.

operations.name: Hob External Tooth Profile
operations.setup_note: Locate on the finished bore with Q against the arbor face and support the thin ring against cutting deflection. Use a drawing-approved profile hob and the confirmed tooth indexing and angular phase; generate F12 with the tooth profile only if its assumed root location is confirmed.

operations.name: Controlled Deburring
operations.setup_note: Support the wheel and protect the functional tooth contours during localized deburring. Remove burrs without rounding the tooth profile, keeping permitted general edge breaks within the drawing's 0.1 mm maximum.

operations.name: Wash and Dry
operations.setup_note: Load finished wheels in separated baskets that protect the tooth profiles and machined faces. Wash and dry in batches within the approved basket capacity before laser marking and final inspection.

operations.name: Laser Mark DMC
operations.setup_note: Fixture the clean wheel with the customer-approved marking area exposed. Apply the DMC containing part number, supplier number, manufacturing date, and individual serial number without affecting functional surfaces.

operations.name: Final Dimensional and Tooth Inspection
operations.setup_note: Locate from Q and the bore using the customer-confirmed datum interpretation for dimensional and geometric checks. Check tooth integrity on all 100 pieces, verify the released tooth profile and indexing, and verify DMC content and readability.

operations.name: Rust Preventive and Pack
operations.setup_note: Handle accepted wheels in separated trays and apply compatible rust preventive. Pack with protection against tooth damage, face distortion, and loss of serial-number traceability.

assumptions.text: The dominant geometry is an annular rotational body despite the complex frame classification; axial holes and slots make the process family hybrid.

With no stated blank or annealed case-hardening supply condition, select a bought ring-rolled blank. Provisional dimensions provide 1 mm radial allowance on the OD and bore and 1 mm on each axial face.

F15 is provisionally an internal shoulder on side B; F16 and F17 are external shoulders on side A. Each receives separate face and diameter sub-operations, and their missing dimensions are not invented; the setup allocation requires confirmation before machining.
F08 is provisionally assigned to the bore entrance on datum-Q face F13. Its explicit 1.5 mm chamfer is distinct from the general 0.1 mm maximum edge break.

F02 is provisionally treated as a hob-generable external tooth form, with F12 generated incidentally by the approved hob profile. Tooth profile, indexing, and the assumed root-radius location require release before tooling procurement or cutting.
DIN class 9 is the external-gear route's provisional quality default, pending confirmation that this unspecified wheel tooth form is governed by that classification. No tooth grinding is included.

The external-gear sequence's locating-surface turning and hobbing steps are retained. Its entry-chamfer step is omitted because no tooth-entry chamfer is identified; F08 is a face-edge chamfer, not evidence of a tooth-entry chamfer.

The preloaded ring-forming sequence is not applicable to a bought ring-rolled blank, so cold rolling, ring coiling, welding, normalizing, shot blasting, and cold sizing are omitted. The internal-gear sequence is not applicable because no internal teeth or spline are identified.

No heat treatment is specified. The induction sequence, its mandatory post-hardening rebore, and its magnetic-particle inspection are therefore not applied; the material remains in the supplied medium-machinability state throughout.
F05 uses the routing view's provisional 12 ±0.2 mm diameter. F06 retains separate cross-axis access, while F07 retains axial access; missing slot extents and basic locations are not inferred.
General deburring must not round the functional tooth profile. The specified R0.5 profile feature is intentional geometry and is not to be created by deburring.
